name: offer_immortality_gives_one_target_creature_deathtouch_and_indestructible_for_the_turn
notes: Printed: 'Target creature gains deathtouch and indestructible until end of turn.' Seat 0 casts Offer Immortality ({1}{B}) at its 1/1 Mite in its first main phase, then attacks with the Mite and with a second, untargeted 1/1 (Plain). Seat 1 blocks each with a 4/4. Mite (deathtouch) kills its 4/4 with its single damage, and survives 4 damage only because it is indestructible (4 damage marked on a toughness-1 creature). The untargeted Plain has neither: it deals 1 damage to its blocker, which survives, and it dies. Only the one target is affected.
